_comment: Curation for projects.json, the README, and www.thedubes.com. Featured repos appear first, in this order; every other public, non-fork repo is listed automatically under 'Everything else'. Taglines and images are optional - the repo description is used when tagline is missing.

featured.title: wthrr
featured.tagline: Animated weather on your macOS desktop: snow, rain, storms, fog and aurora across every display, driven by live weather and controlled from the menu bar.

featured.title: Vibe Stats for macOS
featured.tagline: Menu bar app that tracks Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI and Gemini health per component, so one vendor's bad day doesn't look like an outage of the tool you use.

featured.title: C64 Projects
featured.tagline: 6502 assembly demos and experiments for the Commodore 64, like multiplexing 16 sprites through the VIC-II's eight hardware slots.

featured.title: ReviewAppPerms
featured.tagline: Inspect, audit and revoke macOS privacy permissions. Reads both TCC databases and shows which apps can use your camera, microphone, files and screen.

featured.title: SpaceRunner
featured.tagline: Fast-paced endless runner in space, built with SpriteKit for iOS 26.

featured.title: Lunar Lander
featured.tagline: The classic lander in C++17 for Windows and macOS: gravity, thrust and a fuel gauge between you and the surface.

featured.title: Vibe Stats
featured.tagline: Browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Safari showing component-level status for the AI dev tools you rely on.

featured.title: RetroSVR
featured.tagline: Windows screensaver of classic 8-bit demoscene effects: starfields, plasma and scrollers in chunky 4x pixels.
